lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca8Nb4Cu4O24 (reduced formula Ca2NbCuO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 143), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Nb and Cu each adopt octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Ca centers have eight O neighbors; the O environments involve four Ca neighbors. The octahedra connect through corner-sharing between Cu and Nb polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ca and Cu or Nb polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic neighbor graph.
